content: ![下載數](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fconnorcode.com%2Fapi%2Fdownloads%3Fmodrinth%3DeVxoMKrN%26curseforge%3D1239940&query=%24%5B%27total-human%27%5D&label=downloads&style=for-the-badge&color=0dc362) **本模組曾獲 [GAMESRADAR](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/adventure/as-the-minecraft-movies-infamous-chicken-jockey-scene-continues-going-viral-creative-fans-are-basking-in-the-chaos-with-film-accurate-skins-and-silly-mods/) 報導** **需要安裝 [Jockey API](https://modrinth.com/mod/jockey-api)** 受到《麥塊電影》啟發，此模組讓小殭屍會主動尋找附近的雞，並騎乘其上成為雞騎士。支援普通殭屍、殭屍村民、屍殼及殭屍豬布林！擊敗後有機會掉落「熔岩雞」唱片（1.21.8 以上版本）。 ## 其他騎士模組 - [基岩騎士](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrock-jockey) - [海豚騎士](https://modrinth.com/mod/dolphin-jockey) - [蜘蛛騎士](https://modrinth.com/mod/spider-jockey) ## 需要伺服器嗎？
